name: 46614 · South Bend, IN
findings: ZIP 46614 (South Bend) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46614 (South Bend) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
